text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of Valentine's. While Tracen 
Academy was feeling somehow lively and 
excited, I was working as usual in the 
Trainer's office when—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Whew, good grief. We finally made it. 
...Aand, heave-ho.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Boss. Mind if I spread my food out 
on the tatami? I couldn't find anywhere 
else to relax.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Sis. Mind if I spread my food out 
on the tatami? I couldn't find anywhere 
else to relax.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Well, ya see, today's Valentine's Day, 
right? Everyone's been givin' me 
chocolates left and right, so things got a 
little out of hand."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Inari One was gazing, 
several bags overflowing with chocolate 
were sitting on the tatami platform...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm grateful and all, but... I really 
don't get why everyone's giving me so 
much—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I somehow understood the reason. Her 
cheerful, approachable nature and 
reliable, chic aura must naturally draw 
many people to her.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Well, anyway! It's only good manners to 
truly savor what you've been given. I'll 
make sure to get every last bite down!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, how thoughtful! Nothing beats hot tea 
with sweet treats! Down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Inari One's "Valentine Chocolate 
Tasting Party" began—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm pretty sure this was from that girl 
I ran alongside before. Heh, well isn't it 
shaped cute!”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This one is... Ah, the kid whose shelf I 
fixed! Smells nice, but what is this? Got 
some kind of citrus in it, maybe—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One ate the chocolates she received 
one by one, carefully checking for herself 
who each piece was from...
choice_data_list:
(She's conscientious to a fault, as 
always...)

(She's conscientious to a fault, as 
always...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Phew~, I'm stuffed! Man, every bit of it 
was delicious! I'll have to thank everyone 
later!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight! You went out of your way to 
prepare it for me, so it's only right that 
I do!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now then, now that we've finished 
eating... shall we go take care of the 
other errand?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Here, Boss. This one's from me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Here, Big Sis. This one's from me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the package Inari One handed me was 
an assortment of delicious-looking 
traditional Japanese sweets...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's to thank you for always looking out 
for me. Sorry though, it ain't chocolate. 
It's my favorite Japanese sweets instead.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I'm not really used to 
eating Western-style sweets. I didn't have 
the confidence to pick out chocolates, so 
it ended up turning out like this."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Why, if you don't wanna eat it, you don't 
have to—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After watching Inari One just now, there 
was no way I could refuse to eat it just 
because it wasn't chocolate. Why? Because—
choice_data_list:
Isn't it the stylish thing to savor what 
you're given?

Isn't it the stylish thing to savor what 
you're given?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. When you put it like that, I really 
can't say a thing back!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, thanks for everything, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, thanks for everything, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, eating the wagashi Inari One 
recommended filled my heart with warmth—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the package Inari One handed me was 
an assortment of adorable fox-shaped 
chocolates...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's to thank you for always looking after 
me, and well, since it's Valentine's Day 
and all... here.
choice_data_list: Thank you...! This chocolate is so cute.
Thank you...! This chocolate is so cute.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Just so you know, I'm the one who made 
that—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Though Creek helped me out with a 
bunch of stuff too, ya know!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Honestly, I'm not that confident in how 
it turned out. If it tastes bad, you 
really don't have to eat it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After seeing how Inari One was acting just 
now, there was no way I could refuse to 
eat it just because it might taste bad. 
Why? Because—
choice_data_list:
Isn't it the stylish thing to savor what 
you're given?

Isn't it the stylish thing to savor what 
you're given?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like Inari One, I want to eat this 
while thinking of the person who gave it 
to me, and thinking of Inari One.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. When you hit me with that, I 
can't say a single thing back!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, thanks for everything, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, thanks for everything, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Within the subtly sweet flavor, one could 
feel Inari One's heartfelt gratitude, 
warming the soul—
